breaking.change: A font whose file ships (`runtime true`) now ships only the CJK ideographs, radicals, kana and hangul the game's text shows: the characters of every text asset under `assets/` (string tables, stories, documents) and every file under `src/`, plus its `chars` line. Every other character of the face (Latin, punctuation, symbols) still ships. A built-in style's Chinese face costs a game the characters it uses, not 18–25 MB. A dropped character is one the face lacks, so it falls back to the next font and the missing-glyph report names it. A font pack's faces (`og font add`), loaded on demand, still ship whole.
breaking.fix: If a game shows CJK text that only exists at run time (player names, chat, text from a server), add those characters to the font's `chars` line, or load that text through a font pack.
